### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**7** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **12** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f4dbcc2153566226f283c79c73255369c2c97587` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `e6cc60ff2bc7d4cfa65fdb1d82fc9f469de6df43` — the merge of head `a94ee5a0fa4c04fa494c1b2e43e3d85380662b8e` into base `f4dbcc2153566226f283c79c73255369c2c97587`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin e6cc60ff2bc7d4cfa65fdb1d82fc9f469de6df43 && git checkout e6cc60ff2bc7d4cfa65fdb1d82fc9f469de6df43
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin f4dbcc2153566226f283c79c73255369c2c97587 a94ee5a0fa4c04fa494c1b2e43e3d85380662b8e && git checkout -B drift-repro f4dbcc2153566226f283c79c73255369c2c97587 && git merge --no-ff a94ee5a0fa4c04fa494c1b2e43e3d85380662b8e

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f4dbcc2153566226f283c79c73255369c2c97587
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：MCP `read_file` 读 PDF / Word 时，如果在第 1 页（或第一批段落）读回之前就被停下，回答仍是「没有内容」，说明改为「在读到第 1 页之前就停了，没有拿到任何文字」；读过的页里都没有文字时（比如扫描件），说明改为「已读部分没有找到文字」。拿到了文字的情况说明不变。
- 为什么改：原说明写「在第 0 页后停下，所以文字是部分的」，实际一个字都没给，外部 agent 会照这句话以为拿到了部分文本。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `file-content.ts` 里的说明文字和分支，`content`、`truncated`、`note` 字段形状不变；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/mcp/src/file-content.ts` 的 `cpuBudgetNote` 与 `stoppedExtractionAnswer`；`mcp-file-tools.test.ts` 末尾新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/mcp-file-tools.test.ts`，52 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，区内落地（非受管面、219 行）。L1 意见：卡内修复加同类缺陷的就地修复都有钉子和消融，可落。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-a) · repo:objectstack#5 · head `a94ee5a0fa4c04fa494c1b2e43e3d85380662b8e` · 2026-11-19T01:32Z

- **形态:** draft → `main`, 3 files, +196/−23, 2 commits. `Fixes #34855` on the first content line; no other card number beside a closing keyword. `check-governed-merges --pr 35271`: 0 of 3 paths governed, 219 lines ≤ 3000 → ordinary queue landing. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. Card note "Lands after PR #34853": #34853 is merged.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/34855-read-file-stop-before-page-1.md`, patch for `@objectstack/mcp` (not `private`, published). Sentences read against the diff: the three new note texts (`before page 1 of M was read, so no text came back`, `before page 1 was read`, `before the first paragraph was read`) and the no-text-found text match `cpuBudgetNote` verbatim; "A stop that did return text keeps `truncated: true` and the note … so the text is partial" matches the `gotText` arm and the CONTROL pin. No `content/docs/releases/` change, no unrelated file.
- **差异由 L1 读过:** `cpuBudgetNote(stop, gotText)` with a `BudgetStop` union (`after` | `before`); `pdfAnswer` / `docxAnswer` now build the note (`false` in the empty arm, `true` in the text arm), so a `content: none` answer cannot carry the partial sentence. `stoppedExtractionAnswer` picks `before` when `pages.length === 0` / `paragraphs === 0`. L1 checked the Word edge: `docxXmlText` emits progress only after `paragraphs++` on a closed paragraph, so `paragraphs === 0` never arrives with text, and the in-process path sets `outOfBudget` only at a checkpoint (≥ 64 paragraphs) → `before` is reachable only from the ceiling path with no text, as intended.
- **就地修复（范围外邻接）四条件:** same defect class (a no-text answer saying "partial"), mechanical, same file and functions inside the claim's file surface (`file-content.ts`, claim 6995738937, so no claim revision needed), same gate family and test file; named in the PR body with its own pin and ablation A. Holds.
- **Pins:** new top-level describe with a stand-in worker posting scripted `ExtractionProgress` and never answering: PDF opened then stopped, PDF stopped before open, Word stopped before paragraphs, CONTROL (after page 1, after 64 paragraphs keep `truncated: true` + partial note). In-process pin with the stepping CPU clock for an image-only PDF and a blank Word body. Ablations A (`1 failed | 51 passed`) and B (`2 failed | 50 passed`, CONTROL green) in the PR body, both restored blob == HEAD; A+B together = `origin/main`'s behaviour.
- **门禁:** check-runs on head `a94ee5a0`: 37 success, 16 skipped (UI families, opt-in), 0 failure. Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core (10/10 shards), Build Core, Check Changeset, Type Check · debt ledger all `success`. Dev local NOT MEASURED x2 (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`): both are covered by CI's Lint families on this head, which are green.
- **接受的偏差:** (1) commit trailers model-free per AGENTS.md, not the dispatch text (correct direction); (2) PR body footer layout. Neither moves code.
- **范围外去向:** the ceiling note still names the CPU-time budget when wall-clock stopped the read: documented as deliberate in `stoppedExtractionAnswer`, listed in Acceptance notes, no card needed. `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ai.json` item citing `#stoppedExtractionAnswer` describes the zero-page shape as "content 'none' … the budget sentence as the note": still true after this PR (the note is still the budget sentence, now without "partial"), so no checklist edit is owed.
- **Flake watch (not a REWORK reason):** the stand-in-worker pins wait a real 500 ms ceiling; the scripted progress must arrive inside it. Worker start sits outside the ceiling (per #34853), so the risk is low; if it ever reds on a loaded runner, the carrier is this test file.
- **落地条款:** K = 1 first-parent commit on `main` since merge base `e8a78c4b` (< 15), no new locale pack. Non-governed ⇒ ai-1 lands per `landing-operations.md` (`pr_ready` + auto-merge) after this ACCEPT; on MERGED, close-out on #34855.
